text: これは　ポケモンの　れきしに　のこる　いだいな　しごとじゃー！

structure.jp: ポケモンの　れきしに　のこる
structure.en: that will remain in Pokémon history

structure.jp: いだいな　しごとじゃー！

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.span: れきしに　のこる　いだいな　しごと
patterns.explanation: The phrase ending in a verb sits before a thing and tells you what kind it is. れきしに　のこる　いだいな　しごと = 'a great job that will stay in history'.

patterns.name: 〜だ
patterns.explanation: じゃ is the old-man way of saying だ, 'is'; the long ー is him shouting. しごとじゃー = 'it's a job!'.
